title: Efficacy of the digital application "CHRONIC" against chronic pain.
summary: The aim of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of a 12-week online self-help program designed to reduce pain intensity and pain-related interference in individuals with chronic pain. The program comprises weekly video sessions in which participants are guided by a video-based psychotherapist to gain interactive knowledge about their pain condition and actively work on reducing pain intensity and interference. Eligible participants are adults aged 18 years or older with sufficient proficiency in German and a diagnosis of chronic pain. Exclusion criteria include acute risk of self-harm, uncorrected hearing impairment, and current engagement in psychotherapy.
conditions: chronic pain disorder with somatic and psychological factors

interventions.name: Participants receive one 50-minute session per week, comprising cognitive-behavioral therapy interventions (including mindfulness-based techniques) and physiotherapy. In addition, individualized feedback is provided by the study supervisor. The total program duration is 12 weeks.
